svg.title: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step a thin oxide covers everything: both active areas, a narrow capped gate with nitride blocks on its sidewalls, and a wide stack on the oxide-filled trench. After it resist covers the trench and the wide stack and leaves both active areas open.
